reviews.comment: Great professor, not the most energetic lecturer, but genuinely passionate about the subject. The homework can be rough at times, but he won't include the hardest types of questions on quizzes or exams. Also has a super lenient grading scale. Just make sure to stay on top of the admittedly high workload and you'll be ok.

I consistently did average on tests and managed to get an A because your lowest test gets replaced by the final and doing well in lab balanced out my grade. However, this was the hardest class I have taken to date. I pulled all nighters for tests. 2 pop quizzes every unit. Chem 119 was a breeze compared to this class. Ochem isn't even as hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: If you hate yourself and want to go through unnecessary suffering this is the class for you! He has obviously never taught undergraduates before and assumes you have the same knowledge base as a grad student. After surviving this class I think I can make it through any class tbh. Worst class I've taken to date, considered Q-dropping multiple times

reviews.comment: This dude is crazy. I did 13 hrs of HW the first week. His grading changes from person to person, and one of his answers to questions is to, "use your chemical intuition." He gave a test before a break and then a pop quiz the monday after. He is available outside of class and is a good professor...just beware of what you're getting yourself into.
